business_summary: TOA Corporation provides construction and engineering services in Japan. It involves in contracting and trust of study, planning, design, execution, and supervision of civil engineering, architectural works, and consulting services; design, manufacture, import sale, maintenance service, and lease of machinery, equipment, materials, and other necessary facilities for construction works; dredging, reclamation, and land preparation; sale, purchase, exchange, lease, agency, and management of real estate; construction work on regional, urban, ocean, resource, energy development, and related consulting service; building, in-dock repair, and disassembly of vessels; manufacture and sale machinery equipment for vessels; and ocean-going transportation, domestic sea transportation, intra-harbor transportation, warehousing, and road transportation. It also engages in construction, lease, and management of tourist resort, recreation, athletic, welfare, ceremonial facilities and others; construction and contracting activities for environmental reconstruction and the provision of anti-pollution facilities; acquisition, development, permission, sale for implementation of industrial proprietorship, and computer applied software; survey and geological investigation; collection, transportation, disposal, and recycling of waste; manufacture and sale of recycled waste; agency for non-life insurance, brokerage for life insurance, travel business; sale, lease and maintenance service of office equipment; sale of deep seawater and soft drinks from seawater; sale of medical machine and equipment, operates nursing homes, and home-care service business; power generation based on renewable energy; office service of personnel, labor administration, and accounting; security services; and incidental or related services. The company was formerly known as TOA Harbour Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TOA Corporation in 1987. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
